props.name: dismissDisabled
props.description: Blocks outside presses, Escape, Back, and the accessibility escape.

props.name: itemHoverStyle
props.description: Applied to an enabled item while a pointer hovers it. Layered after itemStyle.

props.name: keyboardOverlap
props.description: Keyboard occlusion height measured inside a native Modal. Takes precedence over bottomInset when greater than 0.

props.name: triggerHoverStyle
props.description: Applied to the trigger while a pointer hovers it (web and pointer-equipped devices). Layered after triggerStyle.

props.name: triggerTestID
props.description: testID on the trigger pressable itself (the actual press target), distinct from the root container testID.

props.name: cancelLabel
props.description: Defaults to strings.cancel.

props.name: cancelStyle
props.description: Per-button container style, layered after the built-in flex sizing.

props.name: cancelVariant
props.description: Defaults to 'secondary'.

props.name: className
props.description: Passed to the native element without interpretation — NativeWind is a host concern (§5).

props.name: confirmLabel
props.description: Defaults to strings.confirm.

props.name: confirmVariant
props.description: Defaults to 'primary', or to 'destructive' when destructive is true.

props.name: loading
props.description: Confirm is loading — cancel is disabled automatically.
